title: Craftable tridentt
description: This datapack add craft for trident
body:
This Datapack craft trident for minecraft in survival 1.21.7-1.21.8 
How to craft -> two breeze rods and 3 quartz.
This datapack ideal if you get a trident but without the grind.!
[Recipe ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb0258fd1f4ac8b977a53e41fa39012aa0e23889.png)
